children.text: Still is a small day spa for massage, facials and body rituals. We keep the rooms quiet, the pace unhurried and the treatments shaped around how you feel on the day.
Every appointment starts as a request. We check availability, ask about any focus areas or preferences and confirm with you before your visit.

data.title: Swedish Massage
data.summary: A classic full-body massage to relieve tension, improve circulation and leave you feeling deeply relaxed.
data.alt: A woman resting face down while a therapist massages her shoulders
data.expect_title: Long, flowing strokes at an easy pace.
data.expect_text: Your therapist uses gentle to medium pressure across the back, shoulders, legs and arms, adjusting as you go. Expect a quiet room, warm towels and time to rest before you leave.

data.title: Hot Stone Massage
data.summary: Warm stones and flowing massage techniques to melt away tension and restore balance.
data.alt: Smooth dark basalt stones placed along a client’s back
data.expect_text: Smooth, heated basalt stones are placed along the spine and used in flowing strokes, letting the muscles soften without strong pressure.

data.title: Deep Tissue Massage
data.summary: A targeted massage to release deep muscle tension and support recovery and mobility.
data.alt: A therapist working firmly on a client’s upper back
data.expect_text: Slower, firmer pressure on areas of tightness such as the neck, shoulders and lower back. Your therapist checks in throughout so the pressure stays comfortable.

data.title: Aromatherapy Massage
data.summary: A soothing full-body massage using blended essential oils to calm the mind and restore inner balance.
data.alt: A relaxed client with eyes closed during a gentle massage
data.expect_title: A blend chosen for how you feel.
data.expect_text: Choose from calming, uplifting or grounding oil blends at the start. A gentle full-body massage follows, finishing with a slow scalp massage.

data.title: Signature Facial
data.summary: A deeply cleansing, nourishing facial tailored to your skin, with a relaxing face and shoulder massage.
data.alt: Rolled towels, a candle and a bowl of salt on a wooden tray
data.expect_text: A double cleanse, gentle exfoliation and a mask chosen for your skin, finished with a face, neck and shoulder massage and a light moisturiser.

data.title: Hydrating Facial
data.summary: Replenishing layers of moisture for dry or tired skin, leaving it soft, supple and comfortable.
data.alt: A plum towel, folded linen and a lit candle on a tray
data.expect_text: Hydrating serums and a cooling cream mask are pressed into the skin, followed by a calming facial massage to finish.

data.title: Calm Skin Facial
data.summary: A gentle, fragrance-free facial for sensitive or reactive skin, designed to soothe redness and restore comfort.
data.alt: Folded towels and a bowl with a plum orchid on a treatment bed
data.expect_text: Minimal, fragrance-free products and light pressure to calm the skin. Ideal before an event or after time in the sun.

data.title: Renewal Facial
data.summary: A brightening facial with gentle exfoliation and a firming massage to refresh dull or tired-looking skin.
data.alt: A wooden tray with bowls, stones and a candle beside a rolled plum towel
data.expect_text: Gentle exfoliation, a brightening mask and a lifting facial massage, with a hand and arm massage while the mask rests.

data.title: The Still Ritual
data.summary: A deeply restorative experience combining soothing touch, warm stones and grounding aromatherapy to calm the mind and relax the body.
data.alt: A smiling client resting while a therapist places warm stones on her back
data.lede: A deeply restorative experience combining soothing touch, warm stones and grounding aromatherapy to calm the mind and relax the body.
data.journey_title: A considered flow, designed for deep rest.

steps.title: Ground
steps.text: A calming aroma ritual to settle the mind and prepare the body.

steps.title: Release
steps.text: A full-body massage using warm stones to ease tension and restore natural flow.

steps.title: Restore
steps.text: Targeted work on areas of tension to rebalance the body and quiet the mind.

steps.title: Renew
steps.text: A soothing scalp, face and décolletage massage to leave you feeling refreshed and reset.

data.expect_title: More than a massage. A return to yourself.
data.expect_text: The Still Ritual is a holistic treatment designed to calm the nervous system, ease physical tension and bring you back into balance. Expect a deeply nurturing experience in a serene, supportive environment, with natural textures, calming scents and unhurried time.

data.title: Mineral Salt Scrub
data.summary: A warm mineral salt exfoliation followed by a rich body oil, leaving skin smooth and softly glowing.
data.alt: A bowl of pink mineral salt beside a plum orchid
data.expect_text: Mineral salts blended with warm oil are worked over the body in slow circles, then a nourishing oil is massaged in to finish.

data.title: Nourishing Body Wrap
data.summary: A cocooning wrap of warm botanical balm while you rest, finished with a light scalp massage.
data.alt: A candlelit stone basin in a quiet treatment room
data.expect_text: After a light exfoliation, a warm botanical balm is applied and you are wrapped in soft linen to rest, with a scalp massage while it works.

data.title: Back & Shoulder Ritual
data.summary: A focused treatment for the back, neck and shoulders with warm stones and a cleansing back mask.
data.alt: Dark stones, a plum orchid and a candle on a wooden tray
data.expect_text: A gentle back cleanse and mask, then warm stones and massage across the back, neck and shoulders. A good choice when time is short.

data.title: Maya Chen
data.bio: Maya’s intuitive touch and calm presence help release tension and restore balance. She specialises in therapeutic massage and bespoke aromatherapy blends tailored to your needs.
data.alt: Portrait of Maya Chen, a therapist with dark wavy hair in a plum uniform

data.title: Elise Rowan
data.bio: Elise combines advanced skincare techniques with a holistic approach to create radiant, healthy skin. Her facials are deeply relaxing, leaving you glowing inside and out.
data.alt: Portrait of Elise Rowan, a therapist with fair wavy hair in a plum uniform

data.title: Nadia Park
data.bio: Nadia’s treatments are grounded, restorative and deeply calming. She specialises in body rituals, hot stone therapy and treatments that reconnect you with a sense of ease.
data.alt: Portrait of Nadia Park, a therapist with dark hair pinned back in a plum uniform

data.title: Bespoke treatments
data.text: Thoughtfully tailored to your needs and how you feel today.

data.title: A calmer you
data.text: Time and space to rest, restore and rebalance.

data.title: A beautiful setting
data.text: Serene spaces, natural textures and a warm, welcoming atmosphere.

data.title: Confirmation
data.text: We’ll review your request and confirm your appointment as soon as possible.

data.title: Need to change?
data.text: If you need to reschedule or cancel, please let us know at least 24 hours in advance.

data.title: Questions?
data.text: If you have any questions about our treatments or need assistance, we’re here to help.
